definitions.preprocessing: File decode, tensor conversion/transfer, model normalization, resizing and batch padding
definitions.inference: Backbone, RPN and RoI heads INCLUDING their internal proposal/box decoding and NMS
definitions.postprocessing: Map boxes to original resolution, CPU transfer and confidence .25 filtering
definitions.end_to_end: Sum of synchronized stages; excludes model load, prior integrity hashes, display/capture, metrics and logging

limitations: Warm filesystem/model; one pass; memory sampled after each image, not peak memory; no video FPS or matched E1 comparison
